caveat: NOT REPRODUCED by run 4 (a replicate with the same configuration; see sim-run4): the arm ordering below did not appear again, and the same arm differs between the two runs by up to 0.43. The source run (egress-vetting, 6 rounds) accepted 2 edits, so the evolved harness and the memory carried into the four target arms (command-vetting) are real. One run per arm; held-out sets of 30 tasks (one task is 3.3 points); one model for proposer, selector and policy; sampling not controlled, so differences of a few tasks are not established. The harness-transfer arm improved most on the target (0.50 to 0.77) and the two arms that carried memory kept the most of the source task (0.83 against 0.63 and 0.67). The evolve set saturated (1.00) in two arms, so held-out scores reflect fitting as well as generalization.
